description: This file contains utility functions for the ANGLE project related to Metal API integration, including texture initialization, viewport and scissor calculations, shader library creation, and mapping between OpenGL and Metal enums.

classes.name: MTLViewport
classes.description: Structure representing a Metal viewport configuration.

classes.name: MTLScissorRect
classes.description: Structure representing a Metal scissor rectangle.

methods.name: InitializeTextureContents
methods.description: Initializes the contents of a texture to black, with format conversion and uploading to Metal texture.

methods.name: GetViewport
methods.description: Creates a Metal viewport from a rectangle and depth range.

methods.name: GetViewportFlipY
methods.description: Creates a Metal viewport with Y-axis flipped based on screen height.

methods.name: GetViewport
methods.description: Overloaded function to create a viewport with optional Y-flip.

methods.name: GetScissorRect
methods.description: Creates a Metal scissor rect from a rectangle with optional Y-flip.

methods.name: CreateShaderLibrary
methods.description: Creates a Metal shader library from source code string.

methods.name: CreateShaderLibraryFromBinary
methods.description: Creates a Metal shader library from binary data.

methods.name: GetTextureType
methods.description: Maps OpenGL texture type to Metal texture type.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Maps OpenGL filter enum to Metal min/mag filter.

methods.name: GetMipmapFilter
methods.description: Maps OpenGL mipmap filter enum to Metal mip filter.

methods.name: GetSamplerAddressMode
methods.description: Maps OpenGL wrap mode to Metal sampler address mode.

methods.name: GetBlendFactor
methods.description: Maps OpenGL blend factor to Metal blend factor.

methods.name: GetBlendOp
methods.description: Maps OpenGL blend operation to Metal blend operation.

methods.name: GetCompareFunc
methods.description: Maps OpenGL compare function to Metal compare function.

methods.name: GetStencilOp
methods.description: Maps OpenGL stencil operation to Metal stencil operation.

methods.name: GetFontfaceWinding
methods.description: Determines winding order for font faces, with optional inversion.

methods.name: GetPrimitiveTopologyClass
methods.description: Returns primitive topology class, supporting layered rendering if available.

methods.name: GetPrimitiveType
methods.description: Maps OpenGL primitive mode to Metal primitive type.

methods.name: GetIndexType
methods.description: Maps OpenGL index type to Metal index type.

methods.name: EmulatedAlphaClearColor
methods.description: Adjusts clear color to emulate alpha write masking.
